entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • BCL GetFolderPath APIs may return empty paths, which dotnetup interprets as an error #54493
  • `dotnet reference remove` doesn't work correctly when a relative path to a directory is passed #54491
  • Dotnetup: Use DefaultHttpClient in DailyChannelResolver #54477

Closed

  • Static `dotnet test` command-line options and ability to break in future MTP versions #49763
  • Improve pipe protocol implementation for 'dotnet test' #50630
  • Revise verbosity of `dotnet test` for MTP #50324
  • dotnetup: Support tar.gz archives on Windows to enable hard link deduplication #54403
  • GenAPI doesn't always add a blank line between types #48830
  • [Proposal] dotnet test: CLI option to override the VSTest/MTP runner choice #54427
  • GenAPI does not handle types in the global namespace correctly #52303
  • GenAPI event declaration pattern is too verbose #48831

PullRequests

Created

  • Exclude scoped CSS assets from publish #54497
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Isolate InfoCommandTests so WithList variants don't read user state #54496
  • Add --use-current-runtime / --ucr support to dotnet test (MTP) #54495
    Area-CLI
  • Fix NU5026: exclude PDB files from TemplateLocator's CopyProjectReferencesToPackage #54494
  • Fix GenAPI omitting explicitly implemented interface events #54492
  • Allow `dotnet test --list-tests json` for Microsoft.Testing.Platform #54490
    Area-CLI
  • migrate PickBestRid #54489
  • Migrate get packages to prune #54488
  • Block --help and --list-tests for MTP test apps when passed via non-CLI channels #54487
    Area-CLI
  • Show currently running tests in dotnet test MTP output (#49712) #54486
  • Re-enable dotnet test tests on macOS ARM64 (#49665) #54485
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.3xx' #54484
  • Add DOTNET_TEST_RUNNER environment variable to select the test runner #54482

  • Dotnetup: Support daily channels #54312
    dotnetup

  • Add AOT tests for NativeAOT CLI entry point #54297
  • Address TODOs in MTP pipe protocol handlers (#50630) #54483
  • clarify that PATH modifications may need to be manual #54481
